artworks.title: Shepherd on a Horse Driving a Herd of Various Animals
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a shepherd with a staff standing on a hillside with a group of animals, likely cattle. The horizon is positioned high in the composition. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes and etching lines for texture and shading. The color palette is mainly brown and sepia. The landscape extends into the distance with hills and possibly faint mountains visible.

artworks.title: Two Women Fording a Creek with a Herd of Cows
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows two figures walking through shallow water, avoiding getting wet. Several cattle also move through the water. In the background, there are hills or small mountains. The artwork is detailed with fine lines, creating movement in the water and clothing. The sky has horizontal lines indicating clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown.

artworks.title: Cosimo de Medici, Prince of Tuscany and Marguerite Louise d'Orléans
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image displays four cherubs surrounding a circular mirror reflecting two side profiles. The cherubs are shown with curly hair and feathered wings, two at the bottom holding the mirror, and the other two at the top holding a smaller sphere and a larger orb. The reflected figures have long, wavy hair and are in profile without clearly defined facial features. Ribbons with the word "COSMOPOS" and decorative elements are behind the cherubs. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Nymph Holding a Large Dog by a Collar
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a walking posture with one arm raised and the other holding a leash attached to a dog. The person's facial features are gentle, with a slightly downward-turned gaze, and their hair is covered. They wear a flowing garment that reaches below the knees and is cinched at the waist. On their back, they carry a quiver filled with arrows. The background includes a large tree with detailed foliage against a cloudy sky, creating a natural setting that suggests movement and depth.

artworks.title: Woman Seated on a Stool
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile with their body slightly turned to the left. They have distinct facial features, short, wavy hair, and wear a draped garment with detailed folds covering their body, including one extended leg. The person's hands are clasped together within the garment. The background is minimalistic with simple line work and shading.

artworks.title: The Toilette of a Bride
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an intimate scene. The figure on the left is seated with a draped garment covering their upper body and holding a cloth to their face. The person on the right is kneeling beside them, holding a vessel with one hand and gently supporting the seated figure's foot with the other hand. The background features draped fabric framing the scene.

artworks.title: Woman with a Young Bull
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body portrait of a seated person on the back of a bull. The person has curly hair, distinct facial features, and a calm expression. They are wearing a flowing garment and holding a stick that stretches across their body to the bull's head. The background has abstract, textured lines.

artworks.title: Child Holding a Puppy
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a child in mid-step with one knee bent, appearing in motion. The child has chubby cheeks, wide eyes, and curly hair. They are wearing a loose garment. The child is holding two animals, likely puppies, while a larger dog is at their feet. In the background, there is a structure with tower-like features and small figures, indicating an outdoor setting with distant people.

artworks.title: Boar Running to the Left
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image features a hunting tableau with a large wild boar on the right, being chased across a pastoral landscape. A rider on horseback pursues the boar in the distance, while a group of hunting dogs engages it on the left. The etching uses crosshatching and fine lines for texture and depth, particularly in foliage and the boar's fur. The color palette is monochromatic in black and white, typical of traditional engravings. The figures are dynamically positioned, conveying motion in a rustic setting.

artworks.title: Doe in a Marsh Attacked by Two Dogs
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a hunting scene. A hunter on a galloping horse is prominent on the left, dressed in fur and holding a spear. In the center, two hunting dogs are confronting a boar. The landscape includes grassy fields, distant mountains, and trees. The etching is detailed with precise lines and a monochromatic sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Boar Chased by a Dog
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a hunting scene with a wild boar being chased by dogs in a landscape. The foreground features the boar being pursued by two dogs. Riders on horseback are also present, heading towards the boar with weapons raised. The background shows a landscape with clouds and trees. The detailed line work highlights the movement and tension in the scene.

artworks.title: Deer Chased by Two Cavaliers
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene. The image features two hunters on galloping horses chasing a stag and its smaller companion across varied landscape. The first hunter in the foreground holds a spear over his head, poised to strike. The second hunter follows closely on horseback. The stag leaps ahead with its antlers displayed. The landscape includes rolling hills and scattered trees, depicted with fine lines for depth and texture. The drawing showcases detailed line work and shading to capture movement.

artworks.title: Small Deer Chased by a Cavalier
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image depicts a hunting scene with a detailed landscape. The horizon is high with mountains and trees in the background. The style resembles etching with intricate line work and cross-hatching for texture. In the foreground, there are two men, a horse, and a dog on the left, and a horseman on the right. In the distance, another rider and hounds chase a deer. The color scheme is monochromatic in brown and off-white tones.

artworks.title: Deer Chased by a Dog to the Right
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a pursuit scene in a natural landscape. A deer leaps in the foreground while a hound runs to the right. In the distance, more hounds and potentially riders chase another deer. The intricate etching style features fine cross-hatching and detailed line work for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of sepia and light-dark contrast. The composition centers around a large tree amid the chase.

artworks.title: Deer Chased by Two Dogs to the Left
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stag being pursued by a dog. The drawing depicts a scene with a stag leaping across the landscape, followed closely by a dog. The background features trees and hills, with a sky filled with clouds. The drawing includes detailed linework for the setting and animals, with cross-hatching for texture and realism.

artworks.title: Stag at Bay
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene with a deer and dogs. The drawing depicts a chase between a deer and hunting dogs. A figure on horseback wields a long spear attempting to engage with the deer. Another figure on horseback is in the background. The scene is set on an open field with foliage and clouds in the distance, providing a sense of movement. The detailed lines and shading enhance the intensity of the scene.

artworks.title: Ostrich Hunt
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ostrich running. The scene depicts an ostrich in motion, dominating the center of the composition with its long legs and fluffy plumage. The background shows land with vegetation and a lightly clouded sky. A dog is also shown running and a distant figure, possibly on horseback, adds an adventurous element to the scene. The drawing showcases a sense of movement and energy, using intricate line work and shading for details.

artworks.title: Two Eagles with Tower in Background
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a detailed illustration of two eagles standing on rocky ground. The birds are depicted with fine line work, emphasizing their feathered texture. In the background, there is a mountainous landscape with sparse vegetation and a structure in the distance.

artworks.title: Two Eagles on a Promitory
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: Two birds of prey are depicted in the image. One bird is sitting and facing upward on the left, while the other is on the right busy with something on the ground. The color palette is mostly brown and black lines on a tan background, resembling an etching style. The larger bird in the foreground has its wings spread back on the left side, while the second bird on the right is bent over, with emphasis on its claws and head. Faint outlines of cliffs and hills are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Two Eagles, One Eating a Small Lamb
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two large birds. One bird stands on the left with its head down, engaged in feeding on something on the ground, while the other bird stands more upright on the right, looking off to the side. The scene is set against a sparse landscape with minimal background detail. The sky is subtly sketched. The drawing is created using fine lines and shading to depict the feathers and textures of the birds.

artworks.title: Two Eagles, Both with Heads Turned to the Left
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds of prey perched on a rocky landscape. The scene shows two large birds positioned among rocks and overlooking a vast terrain. The foreground bird stands on a rocky outcrop with its talons clutching the stone, while its gaze is fixed into the distance. To the left, a second bird occupies another rocky perch with its neck extended and head turned upwards. In the background, there is a rolling landscape with trees, rocky formations, and clouds in the sky. The line work in the drawing gives a sense of texture and movement.

artworks.title: Two Eagles, Both with Heads Turned to the Right
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This image shows two eagles perched in a mountainous landscape. The drawing features two large eagles standing on rocky terrain, with cliffs and a distant peak in the background. Both eagles are depicted in a highly detailed manner, showcasing their sharp beaks and powerful talons. The cross-hatching technique gives texture to their feathers and emphasizes light and shadow, lending a sense of depth and realism to the creatures. The setting is an open sky with a few clouds.

artworks.title: Two Eagles, Both with Heads Turned to the Left, On a High Cliff
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two large birds perched on a rocky landscape. The drawing depicts two birds with detailed feathers using fine lines. One bird is in the foreground on the right, gazing into the distance, while the second bird is placed slightly behind and to the left. The birds appear to be vultures or eagles, evident by their robust build and curved beaks. In the background, a rocky cliff can be seen to the right with minimal sketched lines indicating an expansive sky above. The overall composition captures a sense of wilderness and natural majesty in the backdrop of a rugged landscape.

artworks.title: Head of a Stag Turned Right
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a deer's profile. The image shows the head and upper neck of a deer with detailed antlers. The antlers have a natural curvature and spread of tines. The deer's eye has a highlight, and its mouth is slightly open. The fur texture is detailed to show depth and realism. The drawing has a monochromatic color scheme and precise line work.
